correctness: Existing fixture and drivers, without algorithmic edits: every output element at N=1024, 1000000, 10000000, plus alpha=-2 and alpha=0 at N=1024. All timed processes check every element after the timed interval. rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12. Disjoint restrict buffers are a caller obligation, not a detected runtime property.
sampling: Randomized complete rounds of separate processes for sequential plus all integer team sizes 1..10. Three warmup rounds excluded from fifteen measured rounds. Fixed per-input inner repeats. Preserve all slow configurations. No pooling across sessions, inputs or historical campaigns.
holdout: Freeze session-1 recommendations and hashes before session 2. Evaluate those choices without retuning against the smallest session-2 median including sequential. Inadequacy threshold remains strictly more than 2% slower. Report resource-aware session-2 recommendation separately.
statistics: Median, mean, sample SD, MAD, IQR; paired complete-round percentile bootstrap, 5000 resamples, seed 2026, 95% conditional intervals. Tseq/Tp, Tseq/T1, T1/Tp and (T1/Tp)/p are distinct. Include aggregate timed kernel work reconstructed from per-call times and the complete pipeline wall cost; do not equate them.
cost: Separate deterministic prefix (including actual compilation, correctness and sampling) from LLM decision/validation and promotion. After performance collection, attempt three paired real decision trials on the frozen largest-input session-1 evidence, with deterministic policy as baseline. Installed llama3.1:8b, temperature zero, one call/trial, timeout 180s, no silent retry. If unavailable or timeout, retain evidence and do not substitute historical latency. Costs reuse one prefix and are accounting comparisons, not independent end-to-end runs; amortization uses held-out times. No accepted decision alone implies promotion.
power: AC power with low but charging battery. Record before/after. No exclusive host, thermal or frequency control claimed. Do not overlap benchmarks with tests or inference.
scope: One existing AXPY source, three inputs. Extends the thread grid of the separate six-team campaign, not additional independent programs. The historical 105-sample PREPARED run remains technical validation, not the scientific result. No perf measurements claimed on macOS. No kernel/agent/repair scope expansion.
